# Content Decay

`content-decay` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/content-decay/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which pages are losing search clicks, why, and which should we refresh first?

**Inputs:** A Search Console Pages report comparing two periods of equal length - page, clicks and impressions for both periods, and average position where available

**Output:** Every page with a status and the reason; the refresh list ranked by clicks lost with the likely cause for each; title-and-snippet test candidates measured against your own site's CTR median by position band; rising pages and demand drops; site totals and concentration; findings and a verdict

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill content-decay`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/content-decay/resources/content-decay.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/content-decay/resources/content-decay.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It compares two periods only and cannot see seasonality or a site migration, so a demand drop or a decline may be the calendar, not the page. Compare equal periods and check the same period last year.
- Position is an average across all of a page's queries. A new low-ranking query can worsen the average while the main query held; check the Queries tab before refreshing.
- The CTR median is your own site's, from the rows you pass in. A filtered export skews it, and it is not a benchmark.
- Refresh order is by clicks lost alone. It does not know which pages matter commercially, and pages under 20 previous-period clicks are marked too small rather than judged.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the content checks the live SERP and the Queries tab for each top refresh candidate, and the same period last year for any demand drop, before scheduling the work.
